Agent Name: PublicationData_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The mistake lies in the assumption that the false positive rate (5%) directly translates to the proportion of incorrect papers based on the average p-value of 0.04. This is a conceptual error because the p-value of 0.04 indicates that the findings have a 4% probability of being due to random chance under the null hypothesis. However, the false positive rate (Type I error rate) also depends on other factors, such as the prior probability of the null hypothesis being true and statistical power. The agent failed to account for these factors, leading to an oversimplification of the problem and an incorrect solution.
